sentences.en: So there was a lot of kind of nervous and anxiety on the political level.

sentences.zh: 我认为公众没有把气撒在运动员身上的部分原因，首先是，

sentences.zh: 他们明白他们只是运动员，他们来这里是为了参加比赛，这不应该是一场地缘政治对峙。

sentences.en: So I think from the spectator's point of view, there is that understanding.

sentences.en: And so I think that's one point.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这是一个原因。

sentences.zh: 这是我的第14届奥运会，但很多人开始乘以四，好像奥运会每四年一次，但其实每两年一次，因为我同时负责夏季和冬季奥运会。

sentences.en: So I'm not actually 125 years old, but I have done 14 Olympics.
sentences.zh: 我其实并没有125岁，但我参加过14届奥运会。

sentences.en: Well, that is pretty incredible.
sentences.zh: 哇，那真是太不可思议了。

sentences.en: We've been really focused up until now in the conversation on the politics underlying these games.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，我们的谈话一直非常专注于这些赛事背后的政治因素。

sentences.en: But, you know, ultimately, the Olympics is meant to highlight, obviously, these sort of superhuman feats that sometimes people have spent their entire lives preparing for.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，归根结底，奥运会的意义显然是为了突显那些人们有时倾尽一生去准备的超人壮举。

sentences.en: Before we get into the individual events that are interesting,
sentences.zh: 在我们深入探讨那些有趣的个人项目之前，

sentences.en: I wonder if you could just tell us about any top line big trends that you've noticed with the athletes this year that stand out to you.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是否能告诉我们，今年你在运动员身上观察到的、让你印象深刻的重大趋势。

sentences.en: Well, first of all, the United States is expected to have its best Winter Olympics almost ever.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，美国队有望迎来史上表现最好的冬奥会之一。

sentences.en: You know, they are competitive in so many different sports, you know, figure skating, skiing.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们在许多不同的运动项目中都极具竞争力，比如花样滑冰、滑雪。

sentences.en: You know, we have a star in speed skating, Jordan Stoltz, who could win four gold medals.
sentences.zh: 我们有一位速滑明星，乔丹·斯托尔茨（Jordan Stoltz），他有望赢得四枚金牌。

sentences.en: It's, I don't think I remember an Olympics where we've had so many different possibilities for medals and gold over so many different sports.
sentences.zh: 我不记得有哪届奥运会像这样，我们在这么多不同的运动项目中都有如此多的夺牌和夺金可能。

sentences.en: One thing I've noticed, and perhaps this is perhaps because I'm older now, is there are a lot of there seems to be a lot of older athletes in the Olympics,
sentences.zh: 我注意到的一点，也许是因为我年纪大了，奥运会上似乎有很多年纪较大的运动员，

sentences.en: especially in something like figure skating, where they they used to be 15 or 16 years old.
sentences.zh: 特别是在花样滑冰这样的项目中，以前他们通常只有15或16岁。

sentences.en: And that's across all sports.
sentences.zh: 而且这种情况遍及所有运动项目。

sentences.en: And we should note that old by Olympic standards is still very, very young by normal human standards.
sentences.zh: 我们应该指出，以奥运标准来看的“老”，按人类正常标准来看依然非常非常年轻。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, most of the people in Olympics, at least in my mind, are going to be in their 20s, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在我的印象中，奥运会上的大多数人应该都在20多岁，对吧？

sentences.en: And they're in their prime.

sentences.en: But but, you know, people have been taking better care of their bodies and training much better over the last decade or two.

sentences.en: And so we'll see athletes going for multiple Olympics.
sentences.zh: 所以我们会看到运动员参加多届奥运会。

sentences.en: And that's another thing that that people should keep an eye on is just so many athletes have been to so many Olympics.
sentences.zh: 这也是人们应该关注的另一件事，就是有太多的运动员参加了太多的奥运会。

sentences.en: And in the past, that was so rare.
sentences.zh: 在过去，这非常罕见。

sentences.en: But it's like athletes are, you know, at their third, fourth, fifth Olympics, like it's no big deal.
sentences.zh: 但现在就像运动员参加第三、第四、第五届奥运会一样，没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: Well, somebody that I think fits that profile of both the older athlete and the veteran athlete is Lindsay Vaughn.

sentences.en: Right.

sentences.en: Only in Olympic years, right?

sentences.en: Only in Olympic years.
sentences.zh: 仅限奥运年。

sentences.en: Oh, not compared to the rest of us.
sentences.zh: 哦，跟我们其他人比起来可不算。

sentences.en: But she's, you know, 41 years old is what that would be unheard of decades ago.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，41岁在几十年前是闻所未闻的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Or even like several years ago.
sentences.zh: 甚至就在几年前也是如此。

sentences.en: But she is one of the greatest skiers in American history and one of the greatest really skiers in history.
sentences.zh: 但她是美国历史上最伟大的滑雪运动员之一，也是历史上真正最伟大的滑雪运动员之一。

sentences.en: Well, she is really going for it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她真的在全力以赴。

sentences.en: Lindsay Vaughn, such a fierce competitor come race day.
sentences.zh: 林赛·沃恩，比赛日时是一位如此凶猛的竞争者。

sentences.en: She is a gold medalist from the 2010 Games.
sentences.zh: 她是2010年奥运会的金牌得主。

sentences.en: There is the first ever American woman to win an Olympic gold medal in downhill.
sentences.zh: 她是史上第一位获得奥运会高山滑雪速降金牌的美国女性。

sentences.en: You know, multiple World Cup champion.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她是多届世界杯冠军。

sentences.en: And Lindsay is one of the most daring and fearless Olympic athletes in history.
sentences.zh: 林赛是历史上最大胆、最无畏的奥运选手之一。

sentences.en: So after winning the bronze medal at the 2018 Olympics, she actually retired the very next year at 34.
sentences.zh: 所以在2018年奥运会获得铜牌后，她实际上在第二年就以34岁的高龄退役了。

sentences.en: Her knees were in terrible shape.
sentences.zh: 她的膝盖状况非常糟糕。

sentences.en: Yeah, her body was broken.
sentences.zh: 是的，她的身体已经垮了。

sentences.en: I have so much fun.
sentences.zh: 我玩得很开心。

sentences.en: I love what I do.
sentences.zh: 我热爱我的工作。

sentences.en: My body just can't take another four years.
sentences.zh: 但我的身体实在支撑不了再一个四年了。

sentences.en: But I'm proud.
sentences.zh: 但我很自豪。

sentences.en: I'm proud to have competed for my country.
sentences.zh: 我为能代表我的国家参赛感到自豪。

sentences.en: I'm proud to have given it my all.
sentences.zh: 我为自己付出了全部而感到自豪。

sentences.en: And frankly, people never thought they would see her again.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，人们从没想过还会再见到她。

sentences.en: You know, it's past the past the use by date in that Olympic sport in particular.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这在那个特定的奥运项目中已经过了“保质期”。

sentences.en: Depressing.

sentences.en: That is very depressing.
sentences.zh: 那真的很令人沮丧。

sentences.en: But in 2024, she had a partial knee replacement on her right knee.
sentences.zh: 但在2024年，她对右膝进行了部分置换手术。

sentences.zh: 所以她身体的一部分现在是钛合金做的。

sentences.en: So that part of her body is bionic now.
sentences.zh: 所以她身体的那部分现在是仿生学的了。

sentences.en: And then she, against all odds, she came back to the sport at age 40.
sentences.zh: 然后，她克服重重困难，在40岁时重返赛场。

sentences.en: And Vaughn and her head skis are flying here.

sentences.en: And also against all odds, she actually starts winning.

sentences.en: Wow.

sentences.zh: 历史正在创造中。

Oldest winner of a World Cup race.

sentences.zh: 沃恩做到了。

sentences.en: People were just shocked, right?
sentences.zh: 人们当时都惊呆了，对吧？

sentences.en: Because not only because of the injuries, but because just of the potential for injury, right?
sentences.zh: 不仅是因为伤病，还因为受伤的可能性，对吧？

sentences.zh: 因为她做过所有这些手术。

sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，她还能像以前一样强吗？

sentences.zh: 她还能像以前一样勇敢，全力以赴吗？

sentences.zh: 但她获得了奥运会参赛资格。

sentences.zh: 人们都在等待看她是否能重现辉煌，赢得金牌。

sentences.zh: 她是速降项目夺金的热门人选之一。

sentences.en: And I understand that there was some trouble, right, before she got to the Olympics.
sentences.zh: 我听说在她参加奥运会之前出了一些问题，对吧？

sentences.zh: 告诉我们比赛开始前发生了什么。

sentences.zh: 就在奥运会开幕前九天，当所有人都在等待她盛大回归时。

sentences.zh: 沃恩在哪儿？

sentences.zh: 哦，沃恩撞进防护网了！

sentences.en: Oh my goodness me!
sentences.zh: 天哪！

sentences.en: Lindsay Vaughn has crashed out!
sentences.zh: 林赛·沃恩摔出赛道了！

sentences.en: She tears her ACL, which is a ligament in her left knee.
sentences.zh: 她撕裂了前十字韧带（ACL），那是左膝的一条韧带。

sentences.en: People think, you know, this wonderful, dramatic, great American story comeback has ended.
sentences.zh: 人们以为，这个精彩、戏剧性、伟大的美国回归故事结束了。

sentences.en: But it makes sense that someone like Lindsay Vaughn would decide that it's not going to stop her and she decides to compete in the Olympics anyway.
sentences.zh: 但林赛·沃恩这样的人决定不让这阻止她，并决定无论如何都要参加奥运会，这倒也说得通。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I would imagine that that is a decision that most people absolutely would not have made since it sounds like she did not have a working knee for the Olympics.
sentences.zh: 我想大多数人绝对不会做出那个决定，因为听起来她参加奥运会时膝盖根本没法正常工作。

sentences.en: Yeah, believe me, people, I mean, that was a talking point for people all over the country and all over the world.
sentences.zh: 是的，相信我，伙计们，那是全国乃至全世界人们谈论的话题。

sentences.en: Like, why is this person coming back?
sentences.zh: 就像，这个人为什么要回来？

sentences.en: You know, and can she come back?
sentences.zh: 你知道，她还能回来吗？

sentences.en: Can someone even ski on a knee that doesn't have an ACL?
sentences.zh: 一个人怎么能在没有前十字韧带的膝盖上滑雪呢？

sentences.en: There's always a moment where you break down and you realize the severity of things and that your dreams are slipping through your fingers.
sentences.zh: 总会有那么一刻，你会崩溃，意识到事情的严重性，意识到你的梦想正在指缝间溜走。

sentences.en: But I didn't have that this time.
sentences.zh: 但我这次没有那种感觉。

sentences.en: I'm not letting this slip through my fingers.
sentences.zh: 我不会让它溜走的。

sentences.en: I'm, I'm going to do it.
sentences.zh: 我，我一定要做到。

sentences.en: So everybody was tuned in, you know, when she was at the starting gate.
sentences.zh: 所以当她在起跑门时，所有人都关注着她。

sentences.en: Lindsay Vaughn pulls out of the gate in hopes of more Olympic glory.
sentences.zh: 林赛·沃恩冲出起跑门，怀揣着更多奥运荣耀的希望。

sentences.en: Wondering not only if she could win a medal, but how she could get to the bottom without, you know, without hurting herself.
sentences.zh: 人们不仅想知道她是否能赢得奖牌，还想知道她如何在不伤害自己的情况下滑到终点。

sentences.en: So, unfortunately, that debate ended only 13 seconds into her run.

sentences.zh: 她不得不被空运撤离。

sentences.zh: 我当时不在山上，但人们说那场面相当可怕。

sentences.zh: 他们听到她在山上痛苦地尖叫。

sentences.en: But it was, you know, the hush on the mountain and I'm sure people around the world watching television, people were wondering, wow, you know, this,
sentences.zh: 但你知道，山上陷入了一片寂静，我相信全世界通过电视观看的人们都在想，哇，你知道，这个……

sentences.en: this incredible athlete in American history and skiing history took this incredibly brave chance at coming back for this glory to see if she could get it again.

sentences.en: And she broke her leg.
sentences.zh: 结果她摔断了腿。

sentences.zh: 我叫伊利亚·马里宁。

sentences.en: He did that when he was 13 years old after he landed his first Quad Jump, which is a jump that requires four revolutions in the air.
sentences.zh: 他在13岁时完成了第一次四周跳后就这么说了，那是一个需要空中旋转四周的跳跃。

sentences.en: And since then, he's landed all the variations of the Quad Jump, including the Quad Axle.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，他完成了所有变体的四周跳，包括四周半跳（Quad Axle）。

sentences.en: Just amazing.
sentences.zh: 太神奇了。

sentences.en: First Quad Axle ever performed in an ISU Grand Prix.
sentences.zh: 这是国际滑联大奖赛中首次完成的四周半跳。

sentences.en: The Axle is when you leap into the air going forward instead of backward, which counterintuitively is actually harder to go forward.
sentences.zh: 阿克塞尔跳（Axle）是指向前起跳而不是向后起跳，反直觉的是，向前跳实际上更难。

sentences.en: Because if you fall on a jump going forward, you could smack the ice with your face.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你在向前跳跃时摔倒，你的脸可能会重重地撞在冰面上。

sentences.en: So he does this Quad Axle, which nobody else in the world has ever done in official competition.
sentences.zh: 所以他完成了这个四周半跳，这是世界上从未有人在正式比赛中做到过的动作。

sentences.en: It's incredibly hard.
sentences.zh: 这极其困难。

sentences.en: And every time he does it in competition, it's like the windows shatter because people scream so loud because they're so excited.
sentences.zh: 而且每次他在比赛中完成这个动作，现场就像窗户被震碎了一样，因为观众们太兴奋了，尖叫声震耳欲聋。

sentences.en: Besides the fact that this man has been practicing his whole life and is obviously quite talented,
sentences.zh: 除了他一生都在刻苦练习、显然天赋异禀之外，

sentences.en: is there some other explanation for why he is capable of doing this thing that seemingly few, if any, other people can do?
sentences.zh: 还有什么其他原因能解释他为什么能做到这种似乎很少有人（如果有的话）能做到的事情吗？

sentences.en: I mean, like Simone Biles, Ilya has this sort of innate understanding of where his body is in the air.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就像西蒙·拜尔斯一样，伊利亚对自己的身体在空中的位置有一种与生俱来的感知力。

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我是说，

sentences.en: figure skaters are afraid of trying these things because they're just afraid they're not going to do the revolutions and they're going to get lost in the air and that's when you might fall or,
sentences.zh: 花样滑冰运动员很害怕尝试这些动作，因为他们担心自己无法完成旋转，在空中迷失方向，那样就可能会摔倒，或者，

sentences.en: you know, you could break your ankles or hit your head on the ice and people are afraid of that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你可能会摔断脚踝或者头部撞到冰面上，人们对此感到恐惧。

sentences.en: But he knows exactly if he can get around the four and a half, you know, revolutions.
sentences.zh: 但他非常清楚自己是否能完成那四周半的旋转。

sentences.en: And also in terms of revolutionizing the sport with not only these, all these quad jumps that he does in his routine.
sentences.zh: 而且，他在常规动作中加入的所有这些四周跳，不仅是在革新这项运动。

sentences.en: I mean, he had seven quad jumps in one routine in December and that was a world record.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他在十二月份的一套节目里完成了七个四周跳，那可是世界纪录。

sentences.en: So every time he had an opportunity to jump, it was a quad, which is totally unheard of.
sentences.zh: 所以他每次有机会跳跃时，跳的都是四周跳，这简直闻所未闻。

sentences.en: So he's the best at jumping.
sentences.zh: 所以他是跳跃方面最强的。

sentences.en: But also another thing that he's been doing, which actually doesn't get any points, it's not even style points.
sentences.zh: 但还有一件事他一直在做，这其实没有任何得分，甚至连艺术分都算不上。

sentences.en: It's like fan appreciation points.
sentences.zh: 这更像是粉丝福利分。

sentences.en: Newly legalized element here, the backflip.
sentences.zh: 这里有一个刚被允许的动作，后空翻。

sentences.en: He does a backflip.
sentences.zh: 他做了一个后空翻。

sentences.en: On the ice?
sentences.zh: 在冰上？

sentences.en: On the ice, yeah.
sentences.zh: 在冰上，没错。

sentences.en: So he did the first backflip, official backflip at an Olympics in the team competition.
sentences.zh: 他在团体赛中完成了奥运会历史上第一个正式的后空翻。

sentences.en: And that was the first one in 50 years.
sentences.zh: 那是50年来的第一次。

sentences.en: So the last time was 1976.
sentences.zh: 上一次还是在1976年。

sentences.en: And shortly after that, it was banned because it was too dangerous.
sentences.zh: 在那之后不久，它就被禁了，因为它太危险了。

sentences.en: Actually, a French skater, Surya Bonnelly, did it in 1998, but it was illegal.
sentences.zh: 其实，法国滑冰选手苏里亚·博纳利在1998年做过，但那是违规的。

sentences.en: So they counted it as the last time it was officially done was 50 years ago.
sentences.zh: 所以他们把50年前算作最后一次正式完成的时间。

sentences.en: So he, it's just, it's not your, you know, your grandmother's like classical music kind of balletic routine.
sentences.zh: 所以他，这真的不是你奶奶看的那种古典音乐芭蕾风格的节目。

sentences.en: It's like, you know, he's on fire and people like it.
sentences.zh: 这就像，你知道，他点燃了全场，人们很喜欢。

sentences.en: You know, it's bringing like a freshness to the sport.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这为这项运动带来了一种新鲜感。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So talk us through what happened on Friday night.
sentences.zh: 那么给我们讲讲周五晚上发生了什么。

sentences.en: So he, he had the team event actually the week before and the, he had, he competed twice in that in the short program and the long program.
sentences.zh: 他，他其实前一周参加了团体赛，他在那两次比赛中都出场了，分别是短节目和自由滑。

sentences.en: And it wasn't, it wasn't regular Ilya in those two competitions.
sentences.zh: 在那两场比赛中，他并没有发挥出正常的水平。

sentences.en: Messi landing on that triple axel.
sentences.zh: 落地那个三周半跳真是太棒了。

sentences.en: He, of course, known as the quad guy because of his quad axel.
sentences.zh: 他当然因为四周半跳而被称为“四周跳之王”。

sentences.en: So I almost thought for a second, Johnny, he was going for the quad axel.
sentences.zh: 所以我有一瞬间差点以为，约翰尼，他要挑战四周半跳了。

sentences.en: People were really wondering what was going on with Ilya.
sentences.zh: 人们真的很纳闷伊利亚到底怎么了。

sentences.en: Although he said he was getting better and better and less nervous as the competition went forward.
sentences.zh: 尽管他说随着比赛的进行，他感觉越来越好，紧张感也减少了。

sentences.en: And Friday for the men's free skate was his final chance.
sentences.zh: 而周五的男子自由滑是他最后的机会。

sentences.en: His, the, the moment we've all been waiting for was his, his, his free skate, his long program,
sentences.zh: 他，我们期待已久的时刻就是他的自由滑，他的长节目，

sentences.en: where he was finally going to clinch this gold medal that people have been saying he was going to win for the past really four years.
sentences.zh: 在那里他终于要锁定这枚人们过去四年一直说他会赢的金牌了。

sentences.en: This is place to be.
sentences.zh: 这就是该来的地方。

sentences.en: How to stick it in town tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚如何在城里稳住阵脚。

sentences.en: The crowd, you can sense it a little more revved up than any other night so far.
sentences.zh: 观众们，你能感觉到他们比以往任何一个晚上都要兴奋。

sentences.en: But the day started out really strangely.
sentences.zh: 但这一天开始得非常奇怪。

sentences.en: There were a lot of skaters who were feeling Olympic nerves, a lot of falls during the last group, which is the group that has the best skaters, including Ilya.
sentences.zh: 很多选手都感受到了奥运压力，最后一组（也就是包括伊利亚在内的最强选手组）出现了多次摔倒。

sentences.en: Man taking the ice certainly does have the talent and he's had big moments.
sentences.zh: 这位选手踏上冰面确实很有天赋，他也曾有过高光时刻。

sentences.en: The Kazakh skater, he had the best skate of his life.
sentences.zh: 这位哈萨克斯坦选手，他滑出了人生中最好的一场比赛。

sentences.en: Setting up quad lutz, the second most difficult quad, back outside edge.
sentences.zh: 准备做勾手四周跳，这是第二难的四周跳，后外刃起跳。

sentences.en: So difficult.
sentences.zh: 太难了。

sentences.en: Right on the music.
sentences.zh: 完全卡在音乐点上。

sentences.en: It felt like an Olympic gold medal skate.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像是一场奥运金牌级别的表演。

sentences.en: Look at the numbers.
sentences.zh: 看看分数。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I'd be tired too.
sentences.zh: 我也会累的。

sentences.en: He finished, he was cheering, he was that happiest kid on earth.
sentences.zh: 他滑完了，他在欢呼，他是世界上最开心的孩子。

sentences.en: Talent, Ilya Malinan, moments away from skating for gold.
sentences.zh: 天才，伊利亚·马里宁，距离冲击金牌仅剩片刻。

sentences.en: And then when it came to Ilya, he skated onto the ice and you could tell from the beginning that he wasn't as confident as usual.
sentences.zh: 然后轮到伊利亚时，他滑上冰面，你从一开始就能看出他不像平时那样自信。

sentences.en: Effortless start.
sentences.zh: 轻松的开场。

sentences.en: It did start out pretty well.
sentences.zh: 开始确实还不错。

sentences.en: If he does attempt the quad axle, it will be the next element.
sentences.zh: 如果他尝试四周半跳，那将是下一个动作。

sentences.en: And then went into the corner to try the quad axle.
sentences.zh: 然后他滑向角落准备尝试四周半跳。

sentences.en: He was going for just a single.
sentences.zh: 他原本只想做一个单周跳。

sentences.en: And then he pulled out of it.
sentences.zh: 然后他中途放弃了。

sentences.en: Was going for a quad loop, only a double.
sentences.zh: 本想做一个后外点冰四周跳，结果只做了两周。

sentences.en: We don't usually see Ilya make mistakes like this.
sentences.zh: 我们通常看不到伊利亚犯这样的错误。

sentences.en: From there, it just, it just got worse.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，情况就变得更糟了。

sentences.en: It's like his focus was gone.
sentences.zh: 感觉他完全失去了专注力。

sentences.en: It is not often to see Ilya Malinan fall.
sentences.zh: 很少见到伊利亚·马里宁摔倒。

sentences.en: He fell twice in the program.
sentences.zh: 他在节目中摔了两次。

sentences.en: He even fell on a double jump, which is, you know, it's really mind-blowing because, you know,
sentences.zh: 他甚至在一个两周跳上摔倒了，这，你知道，真的很让人震惊，因为，你知道，

sentences.en: he could do that in his sleep with just wearing one skate and a sock on the other foot.
sentences.zh: 他闭着眼睛，一只脚穿冰鞋，另一只脚穿袜子都能完成那个动作。

sentences.en: We said he could win it with mistakes.
sentences.zh: 我们说过他即使有失误也能赢。

sentences.en: But how many mistakes?
sentences.zh: 但能有多少失误呢？

sentences.en: The last jumping pass here.
sentences.zh: 这是最后一个跳跃动作了。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Oh, my goodness.
sentences.zh: 我的天啊。

sentences.en: Even the backflip, which did receive a roar from the crowd, he didn't do it as well as he usually did.
sentences.zh: 即使是后空翻，虽然赢得了观众的欢呼，但他做得也不如平时好。

sentences.en: And it just, he had this look of fear on his face.
sentences.zh: 他的脸上露出了恐惧的神情。

sentences.en: A reminder that nothing is certain in sports.
sentences.zh: 提醒我们体育运动中没有什么是一定的。

sentences.en: There's no such thing as inevitable.
sentences.zh: 没有什么事情是必然的。

sentences.en: When all is said and done, he gets his score and the whole audience groans.
sentences.zh: 当一切尘埃落定，他拿到分数时，全场观众发出了叹息声。

sentences.en: Nope, not going to get there.
sentences.zh: 不，没戏了。

sentences.en: And that is a shocking show.
sentences.zh: 那真是一场令人震惊的表演。

sentences.en: Because not only did he not win a gold medal.
sentences.zh: 因为他不仅没能赢得金牌。

sentences.en: Ilya Malinan, eighth place.
sentences.zh: 伊利亚·马里宁，第八名。

sentences.en: But he didn't win any medal of any color, which nobody could have predicted.
sentences.zh: 而且他连任何颜色的奖牌都没拿到，这是没人能预料到的。

sentences.en: I think part of what felt so shocking and moving to people was this guy is, as you mentioned, 21 years old.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们感到如此震惊和动容的部分原因是，正如你提到的，这个小伙子才21岁。

sentences.en: And he has just kind of face-planted on the biggest, most elite stage in the world for this sport.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚在世界上这项运动最高、最顶尖的舞台上彻底搞砸了。

sentences.en: And I think people probably felt quite bad for him, just looking at this kid who just seemed so broken down after this.
sentences.zh: 我想人们可能对他感到非常同情，看着这个孩子在赛后显得如此崩溃。

sentences.en: Do you have any sense, given how much confidence he has always projected, obviously he has nicknamed himself the quad god, how did this go so wrong in these last moments?
sentences.zh: 鉴于他一直表现得如此自信，显然他给自己起了个绰号叫“四周跳之神”，你觉得在最后时刻怎么会出错到这种地步？

sentences.en: Yeah, there are a lot of opinions on what happened there.
sentences.zh: 是的，关于那里发生了什么有很多看法。

sentences.en: And, you know, and Simone Biles, the greatest gymnast of all time, was in the stands.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，史上最伟大的体操运动员西蒙·拜尔斯当时就在看台上。

sentences.en: And maybe she knows more than anyone how the pressure of the Olympics can get to somebody.
sentences.zh: 也许她比任何人都更了解奥运会的压力会如何影响一个人。

sentences.en: And afterwards, you know, he came to talk to reporters, and he said something that was really, um, I just was really surprised.
sentences.zh: 赛后，你知道，他来接受记者采访时，说了一些让我非常、嗯，非常惊讶的话。

sentences.en: It was a weird feeling just going into the program.
sentences.zh: 进入比赛时有一种奇怪的感觉。

sentences.en: I just had so many thoughts and memories flood right before I got into my starting pose.
sentences.zh: 就在我摆出起始姿势之前，脑海里涌现出太多的想法和回忆。

sentences.en: And almost, I think it maybe overwhelmed me a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这可能让我有点不知所措了。

sentences.en: You know, I've been through a lot in my life, a lot of, you know, bad and good experiences.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我一生中经历了很多，很多，你知道，糟糕和美好的经历。

sentences.en: So, you know, he said, you know, when he was right before the competition, he felt every single trauma that he ever had in his life pour into his brain,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，他说，在比赛前那一刻，他感觉自己一生中所有的创伤都涌入了大脑，

sentences.en: like every single negative thought pour into his brain.
sentences.zh: 就像每一个负面想法都涌入了大脑。

sentences.en: And he just couldn't stop this, um, lack of confidence.
sentences.zh: 他无法阻止这种，嗯，缺乏自信的感觉。

sentences.en: You know, the pressure of the Olympics is, it's really something different.
sentences.zh: 你知道，奥运会的压力，确实与众不同。

sentences.en: And I think that not a lot of people will understand that.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为很多人不会理解这一点。

sentences.en: They'll only understand that from, you know, the inside.
sentences.zh: 他们只有从，你知道，内部才能理解。

sentences.en: God, that sounds so relatable, just in the sense that I think a lot of people have had an experience where they have this enormous high-pressure situation,
sentences.zh: 天哪，这听起来太有共鸣了，因为我觉得很多人都有过这样的经历，在面临巨大的高压情况时，

sentences.en: and their brain is suddenly filled with negative self-talk, right?
sentences.zh: 大脑突然被负面的自我对话填满，对吧？

sentences.en: And that's basically, it seems, what happened here.
sentences.zh: 而这基本上看起来就是这里发生的事情。

sentences.en: And also...
sentences.zh: 而且还有……

sentences.en: ...could be the Olympic champion.
sentences.zh: ……可能是奥运冠军。

sentences.en: Beijing.
sentences.zh: 北京。

sentences.en: Then I wouldn't have skated like that.
sentences.zh: 那我就不会滑成那样了。

sentences.en: He just said that if they'd sent me to Beijing four years ago, when many thought he should have been on the team, us included, he wouldn't have skated like that.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚说，如果四年前他们派我去北京，当时很多人（包括我们）都认为他应该入选国家队，那我就不会滑成那样了。

sentences.en: He said this thing right after the competition that was so interesting about how he should have been allowed to compete in the last Olympics.
sentences.zh: 他在比赛后说的那番话非常有趣，关于他本应被允许参加上届奥运会。

sentences.en: Do you have any idea what he was referring to, Juliette?
sentences.zh: 朱丽叶，你知道他指的是什么吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So four years ago, he finished second at Nationals.
sentences.zh: 四年前，他在全美锦标赛上获得了第二名。

sentences.en: And typically the top three skaters, you know, if there are three spots for an individual skater, they really pick the top three to go.
sentences.zh: 通常前三名的选手，你知道，如果单人项目有三个名额，他们通常会选前三名去参加。

sentences.en: They do look at, you know, your body of work over, usually it's a couple years.
sentences.zh: 他们确实会看，你知道，你过去几年的整体表现。

sentences.en: And they didn't choose him because they didn't think he was old enough or poised enough, so they chose somebody who finished below him.
sentences.zh: 他们没有选他，因为觉得他不够成熟或不够稳重，所以选了一个排名在他之后的人。

sentences.en: So people were arguing back then that, well, maybe they should have chosen him.
sentences.zh: 所以当时人们争论说，嗯，也许他们应该选他。

sentences.en: You know, maybe he wouldn't have won a gold medal at the Olympics, but it's that, you know, it's what he experienced here,
sentences.zh: 你知道，也许他不会在奥运会上赢得金牌，但这就是，你知道，他在这里所经历的，

sentences.en: which is this pressure of the Olympics and sort of understanding just what it really feels like to have every single person's eye in the whole world on you at that skate.
sentences.zh: 也就是奥运会的压力，以及那种真正体会到全世界所有人的目光都聚焦在你身上时的感觉。

sentences.en: And every sponsor and every social media post and all these things, you know, everybody thinking that, you know, you're going to win the gold medal easily.
sentences.zh: 还有所有的赞助商、所有的社交媒体帖子，所有这些事情，你知道，每个人都认为，你知道，你会轻松赢得金牌。

sentences.en: And, you know, he had to experience what that felt like this year when he was the favorite to win instead of four years ago when, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他今年必须亲身体验那种感觉，因为他是夺冠热门，而不是四年前，你知道，

sentences.en: he would have finished 20th and people would have said that was awesome.
sentences.zh: 那时他可能只会排在第20名，人们会说那已经很棒了。

sentences.en: Less pressure.
sentences.zh: 压力更小。

sentences.en: He's saying, I would have done better under less pressure.
sentences.zh: 他在说，在压力较小的情况下我会表现得更好。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And some people thought that that was kind of a rude thing to say.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为那样说有点没礼貌。

sentences.en: Dave, what a poor loser.
sentences.zh: 戴夫，真是个输不起的人。

sentences.en: But I think people have to remember that this guy is just 21 years old.
sentences.zh: 但我认为人们必须记住，这个小伙子才21岁。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He spent much of his life inside this rink for this one goal, you know, and we're asking him this question like right afterwards, like, why did you lose it?
sentences.zh: 他一生中大部分时间都待在这个冰场里，为了这个目标，你知道，而我们在赛后立刻问他这个问题，比如，你为什么输了？

sentences.en: Like, why did you blow this?
sentences.zh: 比如，你为什么搞砸了？

sentences.en: And and I don't think he meant it in a negative way in terms of like just being cocky.
sentences.zh: 我不认为他是以一种消极的方式，或者说自负的方式说的。

sentences.en: I just think he just had no idea what just hit him.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得他完全不知道刚才发生了什么。

sentences.en: Obviously, figure skaters tend to skew a lot younger than other athletes who compete at the Olympics.
sentences.zh: 显然，花样滑冰运动员往往比参加奥运会的其他运动员年轻得多。

sentences.en: They tend to be in their 20s.
sentences.zh: 他们往往在20多岁。

sentences.en: Ilya Malinan, as we said, is 21.
sentences.zh: 伊利亚·马里宁，正如我们所说，今年21岁。

sentences.en: What are the chances that we might see him at a future Olympics in four years when he'll be 25?
sentences.zh: 我们四年后在未来的奥运会上看到他的几率有多大，那时他25岁？

sentences.en: I think it's 100 percent chance that you'll see him again.
sentences.zh: 我认为你百分之百会再次见到他。

sentences.en: I think Ilya will hit the next Olympics and the Olympics after that.
sentences.zh: 我认为伊利亚会参加下一届奥运会，以及再下一届奥运会。

sentences.en: When I think about what happened to Ilya, I think about what happened to Nathan Chen, who was the gold medalist in 2022.
sentences.zh: 当我想到伊利亚身上发生的事情时，我想到陈巍身上发生的事情，他是2022年的金牌得主。

sentences.en: Nathan Chen, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 陈巍，美国冠军，

sentences.en: champion, capable of five quads in one free program.
sentences.zh: 有能力在一套自由滑节目中完成五个四周跳。

sentences.en: He definitely will be going after two in his short program.
sentences.zh: 他肯定会在短节目中冲击两个四周跳。

sentences.en: Was very young in 2018 and had a kind of a similar experience.
sentences.zh: 他在2018年时非常年轻，也有过类似的经历。

sentences.en: He bailed on his second quad, missed the triple.
sentences.zh: 他在第二个四周跳上失败了，漏掉了三周跳。

sentences.en: He absolutely botched his short program, came out of it losing his chance to win the gold medal.
sentences.zh: 他的短节目彻底搞砸了，这让他失去了夺金的机会。

sentences.en: Our final skater represents the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 最后一位登场的选手代表美国队。

sentences.en: Nathan Chen.
sentences.zh: 内森·陈。

sentences.en: And then came back four years after that and won the gold medal.
sentences.zh: 四年后他卷土重来，赢得了金牌。

sentences.en: Which for me personally, it was one of the most beautiful Olympic moments I'd ever seen.
sentences.zh: 对我个人而言，这是我见过的最美好的奥运时刻之一。

sentences.en: Who ain't got a penny, singing the tip beside you on the ground.
sentences.zh: 那个身无分文、在你身旁地上唱着歌讨小费的人。

sentences.en: When I think of all these people like Simone Biles, Lindsay Vaughn, Nathan Chen, who just happened to be sitting in my row watching Ilya on Friday night.
sentences.zh: 每当我想到西蒙·拜尔斯、林赛·沃恩、内森·陈这些选手时，周五晚上伊利亚比赛时，内森·陈就恰好坐在我那一排观看。

sentences.en: It's a reminder that it's so incredible to watch them because they do things that are superhuman.
sentences.zh: 这提醒着我们，观看他们的比赛是多么不可思议，因为他们做到了超乎常人的壮举。

sentences.en: But it's also incredible to watch them because they're human.
sentences.zh: 但观看他们的比赛之所以不可思议，也是因为他们终究是凡人。

sentences.en: And that's what makes the Olympics so powerful.
sentences.zh: 而这正是奥运会如此震撼人心的原因。

sentences.en: And that's why I've loved to watch it for so many years and what keeps me coming back to cover it every two years.
sentences.zh: 这也是我多年来一直热爱观看奥运会，并坚持每两年回来报道它的原因。
